name: reLive
tagline: Matches fans' concert clips by location and time and stitches them into a song-by-song replay of the show.
problem: Concert videos sit unwatched in camera rolls.
solution: Reads GPS and timestamps from uploaded videos to detect the concert, then syncs clips from different fans into a shared timeline.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a clip and see it placed in the show's timeline with others' angles.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of DigitalOcean” among 127 submissions.
Uses metadata cleverly instead of AI.

lessons: Metadata you already have can power the core feature.
